inboxIntro.intro: DuckMail is a free temporary email service. Opening the page gives you a working address right away — use it to sign up for sites and receive verification codes without exposing your real inbox or inviting follow-up marketing.

noSignup.title: No sign-up
noSignup.desc: No forms, no verification, no personal details. Open the page and it works.

localPassword.title: Your password stays with you
localPassword.desc: A random password is generated in your browser and stored locally. We can't see it or recover it.

instant.title: Mail arrives on its own
instant.desc: New messages show up in the inbox automatically — no manual refresh.

api.title: Open API
api.desc: A Mail.tm-compatible API for scripts and automated testing.

community.title: What are the API Key and domain panel in Settings?
community.p1: They only matter to members of the LinuxDo community. If you're just here to receive mail, ignore them: every built-in temporary domain is free and needs no account or sign-in, and the API can be called directly without any authentication.
community.p2: API Keys are issued free of charge to LinuxDo members. Signing in with a LinuxDo account lets you connect your own domains (LinuxDo trust level 2 or above) and manage hosted Microsoft mailboxes. That is all it adds — the temporary mailbox itself works the same for everyone.

inboxIntro.poweredBy: DuckMail runs its own backend, with Mail.tm as an optional fallback provider. Messages are kept only briefly — act on anything important promptly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: DuckMail Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This document explains policies for the collection, use, and disclosure of personal information on duckmail.sbs. This privacy policy deals with personally-identifiable information (referred to as data below) that may be collected by this site.
privacy.dataCollectionContent: As on many websites, the site editor may automatically receive general information that is contained in server log files, such as your IP address, and cookie information. Information about how advertising may be served on this site (if it is indeed the site editor's policy to display advertising) is set forth below.
privacy.dataUseContent: Data may be used to customize and improve your user experience on this site. Efforts will be made to prevent your data from being made available to third parties unless (i) provided for otherwise in this Privacy Policy; (ii) your consent is obtained, such as when you choose to opt-in or opt-out for the sharing of data; (iii) a service provided on our site requires interaction with a third party, or is provided by a third party, such as an application service provider; (iv) pursuant to legal action or law enforcement; (v) it is found that your use of this site violates the site editor's policy, terms of service, or other usage guidelines, or if it is deemed reasonably necessary by the site editor to protect the site editor's legal rights and/or property; (vi) this site is purchased by a third party, in which case that third party will be able to use the data in the same manner as set forth in this policy.
privacy.cookiesContent: Like many websites, this website sets and uses cookies to enhance your user experience — to remember your personal settings, for instance. Advertisements may display on this website and, if so, may set and access cookies on your computer; such cookies are subject to the privacy policy of the parties providing the advertisement. However, the parties providing the advertising do not have access to this site's cookies. These parties usually use non-personally-identifiable or anonymous codes to obtain information about your visits to this site.
privacy.tempEmailSecurityContent: Information is stored in traditional email for years. This can be hacked or lost due to service failure. By using regular email, regardless of whether your information is important, your personal information is hacked, stolen and abused. Using temporary email can completely prevent personal information loss. Your details: information about your personal and user, IP address, email address, completely confidential. DuckMail service does not store your IP address. This means you will be protected against all unauthorized actions that could compromise your information and harm your privacy.
privacy.dataDeletionContent: All emails and data temporarily stored in our service will be permanently deleted. You can delete your temporary email address at any time using the corresponding Delete button on the homepage. Your privacy is our top priority. You don't need to worry about your data. We will provide comprehensive protection. Access to your data will only be provided to you personally, and only during the validity period of the temporary email address.
privacy.userCareContent: We care about all our users. The management of this website can make changes to this privacy policy.

faqSection.useCasesTitle: Common Use Cases for Temporary Email
faqSection.useCase1: Register on websites or apps without exposing your real email address — avoid spam and promotional emails forever after.
faqSection.useCase2: Sign up for forums, trial platforms, or software testing with no privacy concerns or long-term commitments.
faqSection.useCase3: Developers can test email-sending features without cluttering real inboxes — fast and disposable.
faqSection.useCase4: When a website requires email verification but you prefer not to share your real address, a temporary email is the perfect solution.
faqSection.step1Desc: Open DuckMail and a temporary email address is automatically generated for you — no registration, no waiting.
faqSection.step2Desc: Copy the generated address and paste it into any signup form that requires email verification.
faqSection.step3Desc: Check the DuckMail inbox — your verification code or confirmation email will arrive within seconds. Done!
faqSection.q1: What is a temporary email address?
faqSection.a1: A temporary email address (also known as a disposable or throwaway email) is a short-term email address that can receive messages without requiring any personal information to set up. DuckMail provides free, instant, no-registration temporary email to help protect your privacy online.
faqSection.q2: Is DuckMail completely free to use?
faqSection.a2: Yes, DuckMail is 100% free. No account registration, no payment, and no software download required — just open the website and start using your temporary inbox right away.
faqSection.q3: How long does my temporary email address last?
faqSection.a3: Your temporary email remains active as long as you don't delete the account. Your login credentials are saved in your browser's local storage, so you can return later and continue using the same address. If you clear your browser data, you can recreate the account with the same username and continue receiving emails.
faqSection.q4: Is using a temporary email safe?
faqSection.a4: DuckMail protects your inbox with a randomly generated strong password stored only in your browser. We do not store your IP address or personal information. Using a temporary email for third-party registrations effectively shields your real email from spam, data breaches, and unwanted contact.
faqSection.q5: Can I send emails with DuckMail?
faqSection.a5: DuckMail is currently a receive-only service, focused on helping users receive verification codes and confirmation emails quickly. For sending emails, please use your regular email provider. We concentrate on delivering fast, reliable, and private temporary email reception.
faqSection.q6: Who should use a temporary email service?
faqSection.a6: Anyone who values online privacy can benefit from a disposable email. It's especially useful for everyday users who want to avoid spam, developers testing email workflows, people joining events or trials without sharing real contact details, and anyone needing a quick one-time email verification.
faqSection.q7: Is my email content stored or read by anyone?
faqSection.a7: DuckMail runs its own self-hosted backend API. Emails are stored temporarily for the day and are typically auto-deleted by the system within a few hours — please save any important content promptly. We do not read your emails; only you can access your inbox using your account credentials. Mail.tm is available as an optional fallback provider for some users; please refer to Mail.tm's privacy policy for their data handling practices.

apiDocs.title: API Documentation
apiDocs.subtitle: Welcome to the DuckMail API
apiDocs.description: This API allows you to automate the registration process at various sites which require email confirmation for testing purposes. Usage of our API for illegal activity is strictly prohibited.
apiDocs.authDescription: Most endpoints require authentication via a Bearer Token. You can obtain a token by providing an address and password.
apiDocs.apiKeyDescription_pre: One API Key accesses all your private domains and hosted mailboxes, including account creation and hosted mailbox management. The key starts with `dk_`. Listing, importing, and managing Microsoft hosted mailboxes requires the key. GET /domains and creating a temporary mailbox only need it for private domains. You can obtain your API Key from
apiDocs.contributionsDescription: We welcome developers to create integrations, libraries, and tools for the DuckMail API. If you have any contributions, feel free to contact us or submit a pull request on our GitHub repository.
apiDocs.llmDocsDescription: Plain-text API reference. Share the link with AI assistants to help write integration code.
apiDocs.domainGetDesc: Get the list of available domains. Private domains are returned if an API key is provided.
apiDocs.accountCreateDesc: Create a new email account. Optional expiresIn sets the lifetime in seconds: omit = 24h auto-cleanup, positive number = custom lifetime. 0 or -1 = never expires; use it only when you really need a long-lived mailbox, not as a default. An API key is required if using a private domain.
apiDocs.accountMeDesc: Get information about the currently authenticated account.
apiDocs.accountDeleteDesc: Delete the currently authenticated email account by ID. You can only delete your own account.
apiDocs.tokenDesc: Get an authentication token using an email address and password.
apiDocs.messageListDesc: Get the list of messages in the inbox.
apiDocs.messageGetDesc: Get detailed information for a single message by its ID.
apiDocs.messageDeleteDesc: Delete a message by its ID.
apiDocs.hostedListDesc: List hosted accounts you own, 30 per page, same Hydra pagination as GET /domains. API Key required.
apiDocs.hostedImportDesc: Import hosted mailboxes. password is an independent DuckMail access password, not the Microsoft password. Poll the 202 import result. API Key required.
apiDocs.hostedImportGetDesc: Inspect per-row verification and creation results. Never returns Microsoft credentials or passwords. API Key required.
apiDocs.hostedPatchDesc: Update a hosted account label, pause sync, or enable/disable it. API Key required.
apiDocs.hostedDeleteDesc: Remove hosting, credentials, and cache. Does not delete Microsoft mail. API Key required.
apiDocs.hostedOwnerSyncDesc: Owner-triggered sync for that hosted mailbox. API Key required.
apiDocs.hostedTokenDesc: Mint a mailbox token for one hosted account under your API Key. Send the key in Authorization and only the address in the body, with no password. Use the returned token for /me and /messages.
